# VERSACORE
VERSACORE is a POP and interior contracting business based at M Block, Hafez Baba Nagar, Chandrayangutta, Hyderabad, Telangana 500058.
Owner: Syed Mohammed.
Experience: 12 years in the field.
Completed projects: 700+ (business-reported).
Services: POP and false ceilings; wall panelling; die work; partitions; cabinet work; PVC work of all types; complete interiors. Services can be coordinated with wall panelling and die work.
Selected completed project entries: Bridal Showroom (Moin Bagh); Karachi Bakery (Chandrayangutta and 2 Enjanbowli-area branches); Jannath Welding Mall (Khilwath Road); Melody Muppa (Gachibowli); Raja Deluxe Theatre (Musheerabad); Cris Town Apartment (Ballaguda); Police SI Home Interior (Gurramguda); Rajapushpa project (Narsingi); Alien Space Station (Tellapur); My Home Vihanga (Gachibowli); Kanchanbagh Police Station (Kanchanbagh); Kullur 2 BHK (KCR Nagar); Hera Masjid (Moin Bagh); Golconda Fort Apartment (Golconda).
